correctness.rationale: Under model-1 full-edge replacement, each mixed edge with a mutant vertices and b residents contributes G_r(a,b)=r a(r^{-b}-1)+b(r^a-1) to E[r^{-I_{t+1}}-r^{-I_t}] times r^{-i}/(Td). The two finite geometric sums show G_r(a,b)>0 for r!=1 whenever a,b>=1, a+b>=3; a mixed edge exists for every transient state by connectedness. Finite-state absorption and optional stopping turn strict drift into rho_H(A;r)<M_N(i;r) for r>1 and reverse for 0<r<1; neutral mutant count is a martingale. These quantifiers cover every mixed initial set, positive fitness, and incidence-regular nonuniform edge-size mixtures. Independently checked G>0 in 486 finite rational compositions/rates; universality rests on sums and stopping proof.
